skills.name: [Focus]
skills.description:
Use the power of the Forest Child to mark an ally as a Focal Target.
When you use a Focus skill, the Focal Target becomes the skill's target.
Use Focus repeatedly to cycle the Focal Target to the next ally.
When not in a party, you are always the Focal Target.

skills.name: [Focus] Awaken
skills.description:
Borrows nature's might to awaken the potential of the current Focal Target.
The effects of Awaken do not stack with the Bishop skill 'Benediction.' Awaken's effects are always prioritized.
All party members will temporarily gain the Exhaust effect upon using Awaken, and cannot receive the effects of Awaken again for a set time.
If used on the Focal Target, rather than yourself, you gain the Resonant effect.
